records.quote: Table 1.  Summary of Samples, Test Conditions, and Selected Results [...] Δ %O2 i [...] III-1 Cotton-Fiberglass 40.6 cm 0.37 mm 94 cm 25 cm/s Concurrent 21.2 to 21.0
records.derivation: O2 reading across the Saffire-III concurrent burn as tabulated (start to end: 21.2 then 21.0); it is a range over the test, not a set point. Mapping: NTRS row III-1 is 'Concurrent'; the PSI-100 table (psi-data/PSI-100/Experimental table/PSI-100_Experimental table_SAFFIRE-3.csv, row=1) lists S1 with Direction 'Concurrent', so III-1 -> S1 by flow direction. Caution for the auditor: the two tables do not agree on flow speed (NTRS III-1 '25 cm/s', PSI-100 S1 '30 cm/s'), so the mapping rests on direction only. The column header is 'Δ %O2' with footnote 'i' whose text is not in the indexed pages; the values themselves read as absolute O2 percent (cf. the PSI-98 table, which lists the same Saffire-I burn I-1 as 'Percent O2' '21.5 - 21.7', and PSI-99 table note row=12: 'Note 1 Derived from measured CO2 production and referenced to initial O2 concentration reported by ISS.').
records.flag_notes: UNIT_AMBIGUOUS: column header is a change symbol (Δ %O2) while the cells look like absolute percentages. SHARED_LINEAGE: the same table and the same flight hardware design cover Saffire-I, -II and -III (PSI-98, PSI-99, PSI-100).

records.quote: Table 1.  Summary of Samples, Test Conditions, and Selected Results [...] Δ %O2 i [...] III-2 Cotton-Fiberglass 40.6 cm 0.37 mm ~ 10 cm 25 cm/s Opposed 21.2 to 21.0
records.derivation: O2 reading across the Saffire-III opposed burn as tabulated (start to end: 21.2 then 21.0); a range over the test, not a set point. Mapping: NTRS row III-2 is 'Opposed'; the PSI-100 table (psi-data/PSI-100/Experimental table/PSI-100_Experimental table_SAFFIRE-3.csv, row=2) lists S2 with Direction 'Opposed', so III-2 -> S2 by flow direction. Caution: NTRS gives '25 cm/s' and '~ 10 cm' length for III-2, PSI-100 gives '30 cm/s' and '94 cm' for S2; the mapping rests on direction only. Header 'Δ %O2' with unavailable footnote 'i' (see R501).

lineage: Saffire-I/-II/-III (PSI-98/99/100) share one hardware design and one results table: 'The premise for the design of the flight experiment was that practically all of the hardware would be identical in the three units except possibly for the sample material(s) to be burned.' (SAFFIRE Objectives, Development and Status.pdf, page=2). SAME-R (PSI-101) reflew SAME (PSI-102) hardware: 'SAME-R utilized the SAME hardware used on-orbit.' (psi-data/PSI-101/_investigation/PSI-101.json, section=approach); several SAME engineering documents are filed under both accessions.
